description: This file implements a simulated modem service for handling SIM card operations, including PIN management, file system interactions, and communication with a network service, within a modem simulator environment.

classes.name: SimService
classes.description: Main class implementing the simulated SIM card service, handling commands and managing SIM state.

classes.name: SimFileSystem
classes.description: Nested class managing the XML-based file system representation of the SIM card.

classes.name: PinStatus
classes.description: Class managing PIN and PUK verification, change, and retry counts.

methods.name: InitializeCommandHandlers
methods.description: Sets up command handlers for various AT commands related to SIM operations.

methods.name: InitializeServiceState
methods.description: Initializes the SIM service state, including file system and facility lock states.

methods.name: InitializeSimFileSystemAndSimState
methods.description: Loads the SIM profile XML, sets initial PIN/PUK states, and determines SIM status.

methods.name: HandleSIMStatusReq
methods.description: Handles AT+CPIN? command to report current SIM status.

methods.name: HandleCRSM
methods.description: Handles AT+CRSM command for SIM file access.

methods.name: HandleSIM_IO
methods.description: Handles AT+CRSM commands for reading/writing SIM files.

methods.name: HandleCSIM_IO
methods.description: Handles AT+CSIM commands for SIM card communication.

methods.name: HandleGetIMSI
methods.description: Handles AT+CIMI command to retrieve IMSI.

methods.name: HandleGetIccId
methods.description: Handles AT+CICCID command to retrieve ICCID.

methods.name: HandleFacilityLock
methods.description: Handles AT+CLCK command for facility lock management.

methods.name: HandleOpenLogicalChannel
methods.description: Handles AT+CCHO to open a logical channel to the SIM.

methods.name: HandleCloseLogicalChannel
methods.description: Handles AT+CCHC to close a logical channel.

methods.name: HandleTransmitLogicalChannel
methods.description: Handles AT+CGLA to transmit APDU commands over a logical channel.

methods.name: HandleChangePassword
methods.description: Handles AT+CPWD to change facility lock passwords.

methods.name: HandleQueryRemainTimes
methods.description: Handles AT+CPINR to query remaining PIN/PUK retries.

methods.name: HandleCdmaSubscriptionSource
methods.description: Handles AT+CCSS? to get/set CDMA subscription source.

methods.name: HandleCdmaRoamingPreference
methods.description: Handles AT+WRMP? to get/set CDMA roaming preference.

methods.name: HandleSimAuthentication
methods.description: Handles ^MBAU commands for SIM authentication challenges.

methods.name: HandlePhoneNumberUpdate
methods.description: Handles phone number update commands.

methods.name: GetPhoneNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the phone number from the SIM file system.

methods.name: SetPhoneNumber
methods.description: Sets the phone number in the SIM file system.

methods.name: GetSimStatus
methods.description: Returns current SIM status.

methods.name: GetSimOperator
methods.description: Retrieves the operator IMSI from the SIM file system.

methods.name: CheckPin1AndAdjustSimStatus
methods.description: Verifies PIN1 and updates SIM status accordingly.
